issues.detail: The Greek 'καθως και προς υμας' means 'just as [it does] toward you' or 'as well as to you' (indicating a parallel action/direction), but the Vietnamese 'như đã xảy ra giữa anh em vậy' translates to 'as happened among/between you', which changes the meaning from a parallel direction of the word's movement to a past event occurring within a group.
